q01.query: /* select#1 */ select `a`.`appointment_id` AS `appointment_id`,`p`.`full_name` AS `patient_name`,`d`.`full_name` AS `doctor_name`,coalesce(`sp`.`specialty_name`,'General Practitioner') AS `specialty_name`,`a`.`appointment_date_time` AS `appointment_date_time`,`ds`.`start_time` AS `start_time`,`ds`.`end_time` AS `end_time`,`a`.`status` AS `status` from `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`appointment` `a` join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`patient` `p` join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`doctor` `d` join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`doctor_schedule` `ds` left join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`specialist` `st` on((`st`.`doctor_id` = `d`.`doctor_id`)) left join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`specialty` `sp` on((`sp`.`specialty_id` = `st`.`specialty_id`)) where ((`p`.`patient_id` = `a`.`patient_id`) and (`a`.`doctor_id` = `d`.`doctor_id`) and (`ds`.`schedule_id` = `a`.`schedule_id`) and (cast(`a`.`appointment_date_time` as date) = <cache>((@`report_date`)))) order by `a`.`appointment_date_time`

inputs.operation: Single-row index lookup on st using PRIMARY (doctor_id = d.doctor_id)
Single-row index lookup on sp using PRIMARY (specialty_id = st.specialty_id)
Index lookup on a using fk_appointment_doctor_id (doctor_id = d.doctor_id)
Single-row index lookup on p using PRIMARY (patient_id = a.patient_id)
Single-row index lookup on ds using PRIMARY (schedule_id = a.schedule_id)

q07.query: /* select#1 */ select `p`.`patient_id` AS `patient_id`,`p`.`full_name` AS `full_name`,`mh`.`record_date` AS `record_date`,`mh`.`diagnosis` AS `diagnosis`,`mh`.`symptoms` AS `symptoms`,`d`.`full_name` AS `doctor_name` from `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`medical_history` `mh` join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`consultation_session` `cs` join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`appointment` `a` join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`patient` `p` join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`doctor` `d` where ((`cs`.`session_id` = `mh`.`session_id`) and (`a`.`appointment_id` = `cs`.`appointment_id`) and (`p`.`patient_id` = `a`.`patient_id`) and (`d`.`doctor_id` = `a`.`doctor_id`)) order by `p`.`patient_id`,`mh`.`record_date`

inputs.operation: Single-row index lookup on cs using PRIMARY (session_id = mh.session_id)
Single-row index lookup on a using PRIMARY (appointment_id = cs.appointment_id)
Single-row index lookup on d using PRIMARY (doctor_id = a.doctor_id)
Single-row index lookup on p using PRIMARY (patient_id = a.patient_id)

q08.query: /* select#1 */ select `rx`.`prescription_id` AS `prescription_id`,`a`.`patient_id` AS `patient_id`,`rx`.`prescription_date` AS `prescription_date`,`m`.`medication_name` AS `medication_name`,`pi`.`dosage` AS `dosage`,`pi`.`frequency` AS `frequency`,`pi`.`duration` AS `duration`,`pi`.`special_instructions` AS `special_instructions` from `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`prescription` `rx` join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`consultation_session` `cs` join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`appointment` `a` join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`prescription_item` `pi` join `healthcare_clinic_portal`.`medication` `m` where ((`cs`.`session_id` = `rx`.`session_id`) and (`a`.`appointment_id` = `cs`.`appointment_id`) and (`pi`.`prescription_id` = `rx`.`prescription_id`) and (`m`.`medication_id` = `pi`.`medication_id`)) order by `rx`.`prescription_id`,`m`.`medication_name`

inputs.operation: Single-row index lookup on cs using PRIMARY (session_id = rx.session_id)
Index lookup on pi using uq_prescription_item_medication (prescription_id = rx.prescription_id)
Single-row index lookup on m using PRIMARY (medication_id = pi.medication_id)
Single-row index lookup on a using PRIMARY (appointment_id = cs.appointment_id)
